subject.title: Feature request: Mid-stream message injection (soft steer)

question: Should OpenClaw treat the remaining work as a refreshed PR 89238-style ordinary-message admission fix, or keep a broader product track for true pause-or-abort and resume soft steering beyond boundary steering?
rationale: The source-level gap is real, but the final behavior crosses session-state ownership, message-delivery fallback, channel ingress ordering, and user-visible steering semantics that code inspection alone cannot choose.

options.title: Refresh PR 89238 Path
options.body: Rebase or replace PR https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89238, preserve PR 98126 and terminal-session recovery behavior, and prove ordinary same-session messages reach active-run queue policy.

options.title: Limit Scope To Boundary Steering
options.body: Document that OpenClaw supports boundary steering and explicit control commands for now, while true pause/resume soft steering remains a separate product design.

options.title: Split By Surface
options.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/48003 as the ordinary-message regression tracker and use this issue only for the broader pause/resume lifecycle discussion.

recommendation.title: Refresh PR 89238 Path
recommendation.body: Rebase or replace PR https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89238, preserve PR 98126 and terminal-session recovery behavior, and prove ordinary same-session messages reach active-run queue policy.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent has the strongest current routing signal across active steering, dispatch admission, and maintainer-owned follow-up decisions.
